32827-think-yourself-to-death.creator: Unknown

He shrugged, knowing he would find out soon enough. The Galactic Observer on Ophiuchus IX, a middle-aged Indian from Bombay named Kovandaswamy, wore an immaculate white linen loin cloth on his plump body and a relieved smile on his worried face when Mayhem entered his office. The two men shook hands. "So you're Mayhem?" Kovandaswamy said in English. "They told me to expect you, sir.

arxiv-2211-08583.title: Empirical Study on Optimizer Selection for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
arxiv-2211-08583.creator: Hiroki Naganuma, Kartik Ahuja, Shiro Takagi, Tetsuya Motokawa { naganuma.hiroki, kartik.ahuja } @mila.quebec, { takagi4646, moto.t.03.td } @gmail.com,, Rio Yokota, Kohta Ishikawa, Ikuro Sato, Ioannis Mitliagkas rioyokota@gsic.titech.ac.jp, kishikawa@d-itlab.co.jp, isato@c.titech.ac.jp, ioannis@mila.
arxiv-2211-08583.description: Abstract Modern deep learning systems do not generalize well when the test data distribution is slightly different to the training data distribution. While much promising work has been accomplished to address this fragility, a systematic study of the role of optimizers and their out-of-distribution generalization performance has not been undertaken.

arxiv-2310-05517.title: WeatherGNN: Exploiting Meteo- and Spatial-Dependencies for Local Numerical Weather Prediction Bias-Correction
arxiv-2310-05517.creator: Binqing Wu, Weiqi Chen, Wengwei Wang, Bingqing Peng, Liang Sun, Ling Chen
arxiv-2310-05517.description: Abstract Due to insufficient local area information, numerical weather prediction (NWP) may yield biases for specific areas. Previous studies correct biases mainly by employing handcrafted features or applying data-driven methods intuitively, overlooking the complicated dependencies between weather factors and between areas.

arxiv-2405-03785.title: On Model Theory of Second-Order Objects Thanks: This project has received funding from the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme (grant agreement No 101020762). J. Puljujärvi was partially supported by the Academy of Finland, grant
arxiv-2405-03785.creator: Tapani Hyttinen, Joni Puljujärvi, Davide Emilio Quadrellaro
arxiv-2405-03785.description: Abstract . Motivated by team semantics and existential second-order logic, we develop a model-theoretic framework for studying second-order objects such as sets and relations. We introduce a notion of abstract elementary team categories that generalizes the standard notion of abstract elementary class, and show that it is an example of an accessible category.

arxiv-2506-12770.title: Solving tricky quantum optics problems with assistance from (artificial) intelligence
arxiv-2506-12770.creator: Manas Pandey, Bharath Hebbe Madhusudhana, Saikat Ghosh, Dmitry Budker
arxiv-2506-12770.description: Abstract The capabilities of modern artificial intelligence (AI) as a “scientific collaborator” are explored by engaging it with three nuanced problems in quantum optics: state populations in optical pumping, resonant transitions between decaying states (the Burshtein effect), and degenerate mirrorless lasing.

pmc-10650607.title: Associations of Combined Lifestyle Factors with MAFLD and the Specific Subtypes in Middle-Aged and Elderly Adults: The Dongfeng-Tongji Cohort Study
pmc-10650607.creator: Hongxia Li, Zhiqiang Cao, Jingxi Li, Lei King, Zhuangyu Zhang, Ying Zhao, Siyi Zhang, Yajing Song, Qian Zhang, Liangkai Chen, Yuhan Tang, Lingling Dai, Ping Yao, Robert Wessells, Harvey J Murff

A total of 23,408 middle-aged and elderly individuals were included in a longitudinal study from 2008 to 2018.

pmc-11001318.title: The value of transthoracic echocardiography and chest X-ray in locating the tip of central venous catheter in dialysis patients: a comparative study with computed tomography imaging
pmc-11001318.creator: Meng Zhang, Hui-Ling Liu, Wei-Hong Li, Mu-Zi Li
pmc-11001318.description: To determine the tip position of the central venous catheter (CVC) in patients with dialysis, the guidelines recommend that it be determined using chest radiography (CXR) after catheterization, without fluoroscopy. However, some researchers have proposed that transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) can replace CXR, but this has not been widely adopted.

pmc-11353547.description: To meet the challenges of energy sustainability, the integrated energy system (IES) has become a key component in promoting the development of innovative energy systems. pmc-12468846.title: Diagnostic Modality Influences Tuberculosis Detection in People Living with HIV: Eight Years of Data from a Thai Referral Center
pmc-12468846.creator: Wannarat Pongpirul, Phanupong Phutrakool, Krit Pongpirul, Laurent Bélec
pmc-12468846.description: Background: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a leading cause of death among people living with HIV (PLWH), yet diagnostic methods vary in accuracy, accessibility, and implementation. Understanding how diagnostic modality influences TB detection is essential to optimizing co-infection management. Methods: We conducted a retrospective analysis of institutional data from Bamrasnaradura Infectious Diseases Institute (BIDI), Thailand, covering 2016–2023.

As a result, it is still necessary to urgently carry out related drug development research.

pmc-12739085.title: Viral failure and associated factors in adults on second line antiretroviral therapy in public hospitals of Harari Region and Dire Dawa administration, Eastern Ethiopia
pmc-12739085.creator: Lemid Mustefa, Kirubel Minsamo, Alemayehu Deressa, Dawit Firdisa, Shiferaw Letta
pmc-12739085.description: Background:Virological failure in second-line antiretroviral therapy (ART) occurs when HIV patients have a viral load exceeding 1000 copies/ml, presenting significant public health challenges, including increased risk of transmission of HIV, heightened morbidity and mortality rates, and the risk of developing drug resistance.

pmc-13029022.title: Effects of Isoacid Supplementation on In Vitro Rumen Fermentation, Nutrient Degradability and Bacterial Community Diversity Using Corn Silage–Highland Barley Straw as Substrates in Yaks
pmc-13029022.creator: Can Luo, Fei Jiang, Anyi Zhong, Xinjue He, Xi Liu, Yanling Huang, Yanhua Gao

An in vitro fermentation experiment was conducted with a substrate consisting of 80% whole-plant corn silage and 20% highland barley straw.

pmc-13226942.title: Pseudomonas-driven spoilage and identification of early-warning volatile markers in chilled Shimen Sanhuang chicken
pmc-13226942.creator: Shuai Wang, Enqi He, Lei Zhou, Aihua Lou, Jian Liu, Jin Li, Wei Quan, Zhizhong Zhang, Yan Liu, Qingwu Shen
pmc-13226942.description: This study investigated the spoilage mechanism of chilled Shimen Sanhuang chicken breast, a national geographical indication product from China, during 8 days of refrigerated storage at 4 °C. Integrated analysis revealed progressive quality deterioration, characterized by texture softening, increased pH, and intensified protein and lipid oxidation.

pmc-13579802.title: Knee proprioception in children with spastic cerebral palsy: an observational study
pmc-13579802.creator: Annika Ericson, Åsa Bartonek, Israel Luis, Marie Eriksson, Cecilia Lidbeck
pmc-13579802.description: BackgroundProprioception, the sense of body position and movement, is vital for motor control but has been sparsely explored in children with cerebral palsy (CP), particularly in the lower extremities. This study explored proprioception as the capacity to reproduce and maintain a knee flexion angle in children with CP.

pmc-13678457.title: Alcohol use is common in older patients with fall-related fractures: a secondary analysis from a prospective cohort study using PEth as an objective assessment of consumption
pmc-13678457.creator: Cecilia ROGMARK, Linnea MALMGREN, Anna HOLMGREN, Åsa MAGNUSSON, Helmi-Sisko PYRHÖNEN
pmc-13678457.description: Background and purposeAlcohol increases the risk of falls and complications, but data on alcohol intake among trauma patients is unreliable. Excessive alcohol use can contribute to excess frailty and confusion in frail individuals and increase fall risk in otherwise robust older people. Phosphatidylethanol (PEth) is a biomarker accumulating through repeated alcohol intake, i.e., suitable for screening long-term consumption.
